subject.title: [Feature]: Non-interactive command to use Codex OAuth for model provider

question: Should OpenClaw add a non-interactive OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex OAuth setup path, and which secret-bearing handoff is acceptable for callback or token material?
rationale: This would define new public auth-provider and env/config/CLI behavior around OAuth authorization material, so automation cannot safely choose the security boundary or product contract.

options.title: Design safer auth handoff
options.body: Add a provider-owned non-interactive flow that validates PKCE/state, minimizes callback URL exposure, redacts diagnostics, and documents the supported contract before implementation.

options.title: Accept callback URL env
options.body: Support an environment callback import only with explicit validation, redaction, docs, and upgrade/security proof for shell and CI contexts.

options.title: Defer to existing flows
options.body: Keep API-key, browser/manual paste, device-code, and existing token-paste surfaces as the supported setup paths until a safer stable upstream contract exists.

recommendation.title: Design safer auth handoff
recommendation.body: Add a provider-owned non-interactive flow that validates PKCE/state, minimizes callback URL exposure, redacts diagnostics, and documents the supported contract before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest history across OpenAI provider identity, non-interactive setup helpers, and adjacent auth-provider ownership.
